description: Feature profile of mtl3: hydropathy, entropy, pLDDT, GPI omega-site candidates
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests
from collections import Counter
SEQ = ""
L=len(SEQ)
pdb = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O94317-F1-model_v6.pdb", timeout=120).text
plddt=np.array([float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"])
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
v=np.array([KD[a] for a in SEQ]); kd19=np.convolve(v,np.ones(19)/19,mode='same')
def ent(s):
    cc=Counter(s); n=len(s); return -sum((k/n)*np.log2(k/n) for k in cc.values())
W=21; e=np.array([ent(SEQ[max(0,i-W//2):i+W//2+1]) for i in range(L)])

# ---- secondary structure content from the AlphaFold model (DSSP-free: use HELIX/SHEET records if present)
ss=[l for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith(("HELIX","SHEET"))]
print("Model SS records:", ss if ss else "none")

# ---- GPI omega-site heuristic (Eisenhaber rules): small residue at omega, omega+1, omega+2;
#      polar spacer ~5-12; hydrophobic tail >=11 residues at C-terminus
small=set("GASCND")
tail_start=None
for i in range(L-12, L-40, -1):
    pass
print("\nC-terminal 45 aa:", SEQ[-45:])
cands=[]
for om in range(L-45, L-18):   # omega candidate positions (0-based)
    if SEQ[om] in small and SEQ[om+1] in small and SEQ[om+2] in small:
        spacer=SEQ[om+3:om+13]
        tail=SEQ[om+13:]
        hyd=np.mean([KD[a] for a in tail]) if tail else -9
        cands.append((om+1, SEQ[om:om+3], spacer, len(tail), round(float(hyd),2)))
print("\nomega-site candidates (1-based omega, omega..omega+2, spacer, tail length, tail mean KD):")
for c_ in cands: print("  ", c_)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(11,8.5),sharex=True)
for a in ax:
    a.axvspan(1,22,color="#ffd27f",alpha=.55); a.axvspan(512,534,color="#9fd8a0",alpha=.55)
ax[0].plot(range(1,L+1),kd19,color="#1f4e79",lw=1.2); ax[0].axhline(1.6,ls="--",c="crimson",lw=1)
ax[0].set_ylabel("KD hydropathy\nwindow 19")
ax[0].set_title("mtl3 / SPBC215.13 (O94317, 534 aa): two hydrophobic ends, low-complexity Ser/Thr core, no folded domain")
ax[1].plot(range(1,L+1),e,color="#7030a0",lw=1.2); ax[1].axhline(2.0,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)
ax[1].set_ylabel("Shannon entropy\nwindow 21 (bits)")
ax[2].plot(range(1,L+1),plddt,color="#2e7d32",lw=1.2); ax[2].axhline(50,ls="--",c="crimson",lw=1); ax[2].axhline(70,ls=":",c="grey",lw=1)
ax[2].set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax[2].set_xlabel("residue")
ax[0].annotate("signal peptide 1-22",(11,3.2),ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax[0].annotate("GPI hydrophobic tail",(523,3.2),ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax[2].annotate("72% of residues pLDDT < 50",(270,80),ha="center",fontsize=9,color="crimson")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nSummary numbers")
print(" S+T fraction whole protein: %.3f ; residues 23-500: %.3f"%((SEQ.count('S')+SEQ.count('T'))/L,
      (SEQ[22:500].count('S')+SEQ[22:500].count('T'))/478))
print(" Cys in mature chain 23-511:", SEQ[22:511].count("C"), "| Trp total:", SEQ.count("W"))
print(" mean pLDDT %.1f ; frac<50 %.3f ; frac>70 %.3f"%(plddt.mean(),(plddt<50).mean(),(plddt>70).mean()))
print(" mean pLDDT 1-22 %.1f ; 23-55 %.1f ; 56-500 %.1f ; 501-534 %.1f"%(
      plddt[:22].mean(),plddt[22:55].mean(),plddt[55:500].mean(),plddt[500:].mean()))
